content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Annotation Processing and Symbol Processing** as part of **Annotations, Reflection, and Code Generation**. Annotations and code-generation tools add metadata or generated code; reflection has runtime/tooling costs and Kotlin reflection/JVM APIs have their own maturity considerations. Use the subtopics—Compile-Time Code Analysis, Introduction to Kotlin Symbol Processing (KSP), Choosing Code Generation Over Runtime Reflection—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
